newsitem.title: CANADA: Inco's Voisey's Bay stock falls on delay.
newsitem.headline: Inco's Voisey's Bay stock falls on delay.

text.p: Inco Ltd's Voisey's Bay stock fell 0.55 to 29.60 in Toronto on Friday after the nickel miner said the environmental permit process was moving slowly for its Voisey's Bay nickel-copper deposit in Labrador.
Inco said on Thursday that public hearings were under way, but moving so slowly that the company had no firm target for a conclusion to the permit process.

Inco has said construction on the mine in Labrador would begin once the permits were granted. The Voisey's Bay mine is slated to start producing nickel by the year 2000 and Inco expects production from the mine to be about 270 million pounds of nickel by 2001 or one-third of the company's total production for that year.
Inco shares were down 0.10 to 45.55 in Toronto today.
